paragraphs.text: Richard the Stork (Released in North America as A Stork's Journey, German: Überflieger — Kleine Vögel, großes Geklapper and also known as Little Bird's Big Adventure) is a 2017 animated adventure film. It was directed by and Reza Memari. Richard the Stork premiered at the Berlin International Film Festival in Germany on February 12, 2017. It was released for a short time on Google Play on June 1, 2017. The film was later released in theaters in the United States on June 30, 2017.
A sequel, Richard the Stork and the Mystery of the Great Jewel was released in April 2023.
